conflictsOfInterest: The reviewer is the project founder and owner and the operator whose profiles, standing authorizations and classifier rules SPEC-067 governs. The review records that role explicitly; it is an internal owner decision, not independent external validation.
method: Guided review on 2026-11-22 from interactive questions: scope (10 of 13 tasks done; advisory, executionAuthorization false), two Codex reviews (dad3e7f5 on 2026-11-21: 11 findings, C67-002/003 blocking and fixed in #1477; 5bd9b5c7 on 2026-11-21: 17 findings, all confirmed, C67-012 to C67-019 fixed in #1488 with six new tests that fail on the unfixed code; no third Codex pass by owner decision), the four T011 test modules (207 tests, OK) and the remaining limits. Authority and evidence snapshots frozen historical at 2b48a5d6 (#1489). Evidence hashed at 2b48a5d6.

humanReview.rationale: Approve SPEC-067 as an engineering specification within its documented scope: an advisory compiler for the checkpoint catalog, HITL modes, REQ-003 human-only floors, raise-only risk escalation, the R0-R4 pre-PR review ladder and gate receipts. Accepted limits: (A) T012/C67-005: track-brief free-text fields are not restricted to an identifier charset; (B) T013/C67-006: a profile journal over MAX_BYTES is not refused at save; (C) a receipt records reported reviews and approvals, it does not prove that they occurred; approval provenance stays a caller and store responsibility; (D) profiles that derive the same reasons can share a classification; (E) checks are structural, not scientific proof, and H1 (utility of review depth, evidence/t009.json) has no data. T012 and T013 stay open as their own tasks. This approval grants no tool, merge, release or approval, and executionAuthorization stays false.

milestoneClosure.rationale: T012 and T013 stay open; the milestone holds other open work.
